description: This source file defines the `LoopbackHost` utility with static methods to determine if a given hostname or IP address is a loopback or local network address.

methods.name: isLoopback
methods.description: Checks if the provided hostname or IP address is a loopback address.

methods.name: isLoopbackHost
methods.description: Determines if the provided hostname or IP address string is a loopback address.

methods.name: isLocalNetworkHost
methods.description: Checks if the hostname or IP address is part of the local network.

methods.name: parseIPv4
methods.description: Parses an IPv4 address string into a tuple of four UInt8 bytes.

methods.name: isLocalNetworkIPv4
methods.description: Determines if an IPv4 address tuple belongs to a local network range.
